The [[Rogue Bull]] is an [[beast|animal]] that requires defeating as part of the [[quest]] [[A Mesmer's Burden]]. His pet name is Bill. He belonged to [[Old Mac]]. He will respawn until you kill him with the quest active, after which he will not return.

He cannot be [[Charm Animal|charmed]].

==Notes==
*Unlike other level 5 creatures, the Rogue Bull only has 80 [[health]]. However, it has high armor rating. This appears to encourage the use of [[Conjure Phantasm]] during A Mesmer's Burden.
{{anomaly|Its corpse never disappears.}}

==Trivia==
* Bill and [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth]] are the only foes in pre-Searing with an [[elite skill]]. Neither one can be captured, since the [[Signet of Capture]] cannot be obtained in pre-Searing.
** In {{reforgedmode}}, [[Grawl Crone]]s, [[Grawl Fighter]]s, and [[Maz Scourgeheart]] also use elite skills in pre-Searing.
* At least one of the Rogue Bull's horns survives into [[Guild Wars 2]] as [[gw2:Horn of the Rogue Bull|Horn of the Rogue Bull]].
